subject: Novaforge renewal: usage & optimization review + term options
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Samira Qureshi <s.qureshi@novaforge.ai>, Novaforge Procurement <procurement@novaforge.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jan 2028 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Novaforge renewal: usage & optimization review + term options

Hi Samira / Novaforge team,

Thanks for the quick sync last week. I promised to follow up with a short health/usage recap and a couple of concrete term options that reduce unit cost while preserving performance SLA. Attached are the Q4 usage export and the perf report for December. Highlights up front: 

- Q4 average monthly token consumption: 18.2M tokens (Dec spike to 24M).
- 22% month-over-month growth in active requests; forecasted 28% QoQ if current feature rollout continues.
- 95th pct latency on hosted endpoint: ~280ms; 99th: ~430ms.
- Current blended cost: $1.40 per 1k tokens (hosted); projected to drop to $0.98 with a Dedicated 12-mo commit + model mix optimization.

Proposals (high level):
1) 12-month Dedicated pool (baseline) — 30% unit cost reduction, guarantee burst headroom for peak hours, SLA: 99.95% monthly uptime.
2) 6-month accelerated term + burst credits — lower commitment but smaller cost delta (~18% savings), includes automatic quantization profile to reduce GPU memory pressure.
3) Hosted + caching pilot — minimal term change, short performance optimization project (4 weeks) to capture 8–12% savings before renewal.

I've attached a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) v1 with milestones for procurement/legal, an ops runbook for the Dedicated cutover, and a short pricing options PDF. Can you confirm which option you want priced and who on your side will own procurement/PO? If helpful, I can put together a two-slide summary for your execs.

Thanks,

— Tessa
Tessa Morgan | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: novaforge_usage_q4_2027.csv (csv)
Attachment: novaforge_perf_report_q4_2027.pdf (pdf)
Attachment: mutual_action_plan_novaforge_renewal_v1.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Samira Qureshi <s.qureshi@novaforge.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Novaforge Procurement <procurement@novaforge.ai>
Date: Fri, 19 Jan 2028 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Novaforge renewal: usage & optimization review + term options

Hi Tessa — thanks for this. Helpful breakdown. A couple quick notes: 

- The spike in Dec was driven by a feature flag we enabled for a pilot; we'll wind that down in Feb, but overall the growth trend looks real.
- Can you provide a one-page pricing summary that shows: current baseline, Dedicated 12-mo, and Dedicated 24-mo with estimated monthly cash flows? Procurement will need to see NPV-style numbers.
- Please include a short note about data residency and audit logs for the Dedicated option (our security team is strict on log retention windows).

Tagging Procurement / Alan Park who manages vendor SOWs. Alan — can you share the best email/PO template we should return?

Best,
Samira
Samira Qureshi | Head of AI Platform, Novaforge

Hi Tessa,

We reviewed the attachments and Samira's notes. Procurement would like: 

1) A redlined pricing table showing list price, proposed committed price, and incremental costs for burst credits.
2) A short SOW template (1–2 pages) outlining change window and rollback plan for Dedicated cutover.
3) Confirmation on log export cadence and retention for audit (we need 12 months of token-level audit logs and continuous delivery of logs to our S3 bucket).

Send to me and I'll route to Finance; include payment terms (Net 45 at minimum).

Thanks,

Alan / Samira — appreciate the clarity. Looping in Ben (Sales Ops) and Neha (Customer Success) so we can respond to procurement items in one shot. Summary of ask and attachments I am sending: 

- Pricing options PDF (attached) — includes list vs committed tables for 12/24 mo, burst credit pricing, and example cash-flow at Net45.
- SOW draft (attached) — one-page cutover/rollback window, expected blackout windows, and point of contact.
- Audit/logs addendum — we can deliver token-level logs on a daily export to your S3. We'll confirm the retention policy and provide a signed addendum if required.

Next steps I suggest:
1) We deliver the one-page pricing + SOW and a 2-slide executive summary by EOD Tuesday (Jan 23).
2) Alan/procurement confirm PO template and desired payment term.
3) If committed 12 or 24 mo is chosen, we'll prepare a DocuSign proposal and an ops cutover slot for March 6–10 (flexible).

Ben / Neha — can you confirm the pricing figures in the attached PDF and whether the March cutover window looks okay from an ops perspective?

Thanks,
Tessa

All — reviewed the pricing PDF. Numbers look right to me for the 12-mo commit: 

- Committed baseline: 12M tokens/month guaranteed; 30% off list (effective blended $0.98/1k).
- Burst credits priced at $0.011 per 1k tokens over baseline (capable of covering spikes up to +80% for designated windows).
- Ops: March 6–10 looks fine; we'll allocate a small runbook and a fallback window on March 13.

Marissa — can Legal expedite a quick addendum for the audit/logs retention clause? Procurement flagged 12 months and S3 export; they may want an SLA on log delivery.

I'll draft an internal note to attach to the DocuSign packet. We should be ready to send a signed proposal within 48 hours of procurement confirming payment terms.

— Ben
